newsitem.title: BELGIUM: GIMV books cap gain on Innogenetics sale.
newsitem.headline: GIMV books cap gain on Innogenetics sale.

text.p: Belgian holding company GIMV said on Friday it had booked a capital gain of 302.4 million francs on the sale earlier this year of part of its stake in Belgian bio-tech firm Innogenetics.
The sale reduces GIMV's stake in Innogenetics to some six percent from 10.7 percent, the company said.

It added that the sale, following a six-month lock-up after the flotation of Innogenetics on the EASDAQ growth stocks market last November, was in line with its policy of keeping small stakes in an array of enterprises.
GIMV said the capital gain would be booked in the current book year, thereby raising its prospects by more than had been foreseen.
